title: Kiln registry schema (schema/registry/<registry>.json), registrySchema 1
description: One registry of Kiln's registry stage: its Kiln fields, their types and ranges, and when an edit of each takes effect (applies). tools/registrygen/registrygen.py reads these files and writes the C# types (Kiln.Registry), the native descriptor (schema.g.h), the data section's schema and the docs pages; schema/registry/ids.lock.json keeps every published name so that none is reused. Kiln names only: no game type, member or offset appears here (those are in regmap/).

registry.description: The registry's name: the first part of a qualified field (items.maxStack).

version.description: The registry's schema version: 0.x while experimental (0.<minor> is the breaking line), from 1.0.0 frozen with API 1.0.0 (<major> is the breaking line). A breaking step ships schema/registry/migrations/<registry>-<from>-<to>.json.

stability.description: experimental: the C# types carry [Experimental(experimentalId)] and may change in any release; stable: frozen by the API 1.0.0 contract (additive only).

editsPerCall.description: How many edits of this registry one call takes: one OnRegistry callback (one phase of one entry point), one Registry.Change draft, one code batch at the stage. A call with more is refused whole (kiln.log, registry.json). Default 4096; a registry declares more when every field of every entry of the current game data needs it.

remove.description: What removing an entry means; false: entries cannot be removed.

raw.description: Whether edits may name raw game paths (the Advanced tier).

typeName.description: The C# name of an entry (ItemEntry is typeName Item + Entry); default: the registry's name in Pascal case.

applies.description: now: takes effect at the next use; worldLoad: needs a world (re)load; restart: needs a game restart. Every leaf field has one (its own or its parent's).

ops.description: number: set and the relative ops (mul, add, min, max, raiseOnly, lowerOnly); set: a value only; list: clear, append, remove, replace; indexed: a list of fixed length, one element at a time; none: read-only.

registry.description: ref: the registry whose ids the field holds.

formula.description: The Kiln formula between this field and the game's numbers (regmap and formulas.h).

typeName.description: The C# name of this field's struct, list element or enum type (default: the entry's typeName + the field's name).

optional.description: A ref that may be absent (cleared).

nullValue.description: An enum: the value its C# property reads as null (the property is the nullable of an enum of the other values, which typeName may share with another field: loot.fixedRarity's none, RegistryRarity?). C# only, not the field's contract.

fixedLength.description: A list of exactly this many elements (ops indexed).

lengthField.description: A list as long as this read-only whole-number field of the registry, plus lengthOffset (ops indexed).

joinedClient.description: Separate from local applies: when a joined Kiln client can consume a server edit. unknown: no proven promise; localOnly: client authors it itself; serverOnly: no client copy required.
